description: Normalized method fingerprints that differ from the 4.1.22 baseline but were reviewed against the SDC native add-on. Each entry names the upstream source reviewed and the add-on change or test covering it. Static review only; native acceptance remains separate.

handleRequestToolApproval.review: Resolver and message are registered before the display post; a failed post denies only that approval. adapters/cline/src/native-controls.ts applies the same native deny (APPROVAL_DISPLAY_FAILED) because its resolver wrapper defeats the native identity check. Covered by tests/cline-4.1.23-controls.test.mjs.

clearPending.review: Approval denial moved into denyPendingToolApproval with the same record-then-resolve behavior; it reads the wrapped resolver, so add-on receipts still settle. Covered by tests/cline-4.1.23-controls.test.mjs.

denyPendingToolApproval.review: New helper: clears the resolver and message, records the denial, then resolves approved=false. Used by the add-on's display-failure handling. Covered by tests/cline-4.1.23-controls.test.mjs.
